subject: POC: Split-day onsite + virtual runbook / prompt & load rehearsal
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmelogistics.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Ops Team <ops@acmelogistics.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC scheduling — thinking about a split day format

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineering leads (platform + SRE) would like to do a split kickoff: a short virtual primer in the morning (architecture, prompt expectations, routing policy review) and then an onsite hands-on session in the afternoon to run prompt reviews and a targeted load rehearsal against our staging subnet.

Can you do Tue 11 May for the primer (09:00–10:30 PT) and Wed 12 May for the onsite hands-on (13:00–17:00 PT)? The onsite will require visitor badges; our security team needs site access forms 48 hours in advance.

A few specifics we need:
- Runbook / agenda so our SREs know the load windows and expected max concurrent users.
- A list of prompts and expected routing fallbacks (we need to know how Redwood will behave if the primary model is saturated).
- Confirmation about recording: our policy requires explicit consent from Redwoods presenters if we record.

Attendees: Jordan Lee (platform), Maria Gonzales (SRE), Ops Team.

If those dates don't work, we can move to the following week.

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Lee
Senior Platform Engineer — Acme Logistics
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC scheduling — thinking about a split day format

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear ask. The split-day plan makes a lot of sense for what you described. We can do the virtual primer Tue 11 May 09:00–10:30 PT and the onsite hands-on Wed 12 May 13:00–17:00 PT. I'll hold both slots and send calendar invites once the team confirms equipment/rooms.

What we'll deliver ahead of time:
- Redwood split-day runbook (agenda + step-by-step playbook) — attached as PDF.
- Prompt set v1 (CSV) and short notes on routing/fallback heuristics.
- Preflight checklist for the onsite (badging cutoffs, AV contact, projector & HDMI adapters).

A couple of asks from our side:
1) Please return a completed site_access_form.pdf with the full attendee list and ID types for badging by Mon 10 May EOD. Security requires names and company IDs 48 hrs prior.
2) Confirm whether you want the afternoon hands-on recorded. We will only record with explicit consent from both sides.
3) We'll run a 30-minute remote dry-run on Mon 10 May 08:30 PT to validate Zoom and token routing to your staging subnet. Can your SREs join?

Diego will own the AV/room setup and Marcus will run the load rehearsal. Monica will coordinate attendee invites.

Attaching: redwood-split-day-runbook.pdf, prompt-set-v1.csv, site_access_form.pdf

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC scheduling — room / AV / load windows (internal)

Quick internal note on the logistics —

Proposed onsite layout for Wed 12 May (13:00–17:00):
- Room A (main lab): 12 people, projector, wired network patch for our test GPU node.
- Room B (observation + breakout): 8 people, Zoom-enabled for remote stakeholders.

Planned rehearsal windows (to put in runbook):
- 13:15–13:45: Prompt review & baseline latency sweep (single-user).
- 14:00–15:00: Gradual concurrency ramp (10→100 concurrent sessions) to validate routing & KV cache warmup.
- 15:15–15:30: Break & rollback plan review.
- 15:30–16:30: Saturation test with synthetic traffic and automated fallback to smaller quantized variants.
- 16:30–16:55: Post-test quality spot checks and logs export.

Checklist items:
- IP allowlist from Acme by Mon 10 May (we need to add staging addresses) — I'll circulate ip-allowlist.txt
- Onsite power strip + HDMI adapters — Marcus please confirm you can pack them.
- Confirm whether Acme allows screen recording; if not, set Zoom to live stream off and do local-only recording (with consent).

I'll add these into the runbook and the internal ops page.

- Diego
Engineering Lead, Field Ops
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmelogistics.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Ops Team <ops@acmelogistics.com>, security@acmelogistics.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC scheduling — split day confirmations

Kimberly —

Confirmed. We can provide the attendee list and IDs by Mon 10 May EOD. Recording: Acme is OK with recording the virtual primer only; security requires that onsite hands-on not be recorded. We will join the preflight dry-run Mon 10 May 08:30 PT (Maria Gonzales will be present).

Two constraints to flag:
- Badging desk closes at 16:00 local time; any late arrivals after 16:00 will need to be escorted.
- Our network team requires a signed SOW + IP allowlist before we enable staging traffic. I sent the DocuSign SOW link to procurement.

Attendees (prelim): Jordan Lee, Maria Gonzales, Carlos Ruiz (SRE), Ops Desk.

Thanks — Jordan
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC scheduling — split day confirmations

Thanks Jordan — all noted. I updated the runbook to mark onsite as "no recording" and virtual primer as "recorded with consent". Calendar invites will go out today with Zoom for the primer and a separate onsite invite (room details + AV contact).

Action items for Acme:
- Return completed site_access_form.pdf with attendee names/IDs by Mon 10 May EOD.
- Complete DocuSign SOW so Diego can request IP whitelisting.
- Share any additional high-priority prompts for the afternoon session by Tue 4 May noon PT so Marcus can incorporate them into the load script.

We will do the 30-minute preflight dry-run Mon 10 May 08:30 PT as requested — Marcus and Neha will join.

Attachments: ip-allowlist.txt (placeholder)

Look forward to it — Kim
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
